surface: Citing Pacioli as proof that the modern United States is an obligated debtor to issuing creditors, then treating UCC/TFX outcomes as following from 1494.
why_static: Particularis teaches Venetian Per/A journal grammar and double Ledger posting. It does not enact UCC Article 3, Fiscal Service reclamations, or a settled sovereign-debtor claim. Bridging Pacioli → modern US debtor without labeling the bridge as contested/orientation is myth-as-settled.
epistemic_note: US-debtor metaphor may live in loyal-opposition cockpit talk; never as Pacioli black-letter.
